newsitem.title: CHINA: China says over 10 million T of damp grain may rot.
newsitem.headline: China says over 10 million T of damp grain may rot.

text.p: More than 10 million tonnes of grain in China's northeastern corn producing regions could rot because of warm weather and a bumper harvest that has caused storage difficulties, the China Business Daily said on Monday.

Grain officials in China's main corn producing provinces of Jilin and Heilongjiang have worked round-the-clock to try to dry out the damp grain since early this year, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
China's northeastern provinces reported two consecutive bumper grain harvests in 1995 and in 1996, creating high pressure on state grain reserves, it said.

Since late 1996 China has shipped 3.5 million tonnes of corn from key growing areas in the north to the high-consuming south to cut northern stockpiles. A further 3.0 million tonnes were now being moved, state media said.
